model.architecture_notes: E2B: 28 sliding layers at head_dim 256 plus 7 full-attention layers at global_head_dim 512; 8 query heads to 1 KV head. transformers owns the cache here -- there is no hand-written ring and no padding.

memory.notes: Dense float16, no PLE quantisation and no int8 lm_head -- those are JAX-port levers with no analogue here. E2B KV is ~18 KiB/token, so at 4096 the whole cache is tens of MiB and is not the binding constraint.

notes: Decode 10.27-10.91 tok/s across a 92-3746 token context range: flat, so decode is set by the weights rather than by the context.
Quote the decode figures, not end-to-end: they come from tpu_jax_decode_tokens_per_second, which times decode alone. Both are in sweep.json and they do not agree.
